mapper.select: select f.id as id, f.goods_id as goodsId, ifnull(g.name, '商品已失效') as goodsName, g.image as image, g.price as price, g.description as description, (g.status = '1') as onSale, g.sold_out as soldOut from biz_goods_favorite f left join biz_goods g on g.id = f.goods_id where f.member_id = #{memberId} order by f.id desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}
